_provenance.method: XOR-0x73 decode of the sane-magic static-actor table; records are [u32 BE actor id][NUL-terminated classPath]. Record count cross-checked against the header count field.
limitations: Covers script actors only (/Command, /Quest, /Status, /Judge); NPC actor classes (ids 1000001+) are bound server-side and are absent from the client install.
